content.text: We need identity ground truth for FR-040 that is not LoCoMo.
Settled: the hand-labelled clusters live in evaluation/data/identity/labelled.jsonl, one JSON object per line, scored by evaluation/identity.py.

A bare name too generic to attribute to one referent in prose (base.py, core.py, Memory, Decoder) is dropped from the cluster, keeping the qualified forms, because a labeller reading "the decoder" cannot say which referent is meant.
The invariants are checked by tests/evaluation/test_identity_sample.py: at least 200 clusters, at least two mentions each, every mention in exactly one cluster.
